state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors prove (Proposition 1) that any PVG formulation in which the verifier sees the problem instance before selecting its strategy has bad equilibria: converging to an equilibrium is neither necessary nor sufficient for a complete and sound protocol, because the verifier can choose the constant policy returning the correct label (the 'trivial verifier' failure mode).
title: PVG: showing the verifier the instance before it commits gives a trivial verifier
